label: PF Backlog 95
title: Backend: per-feature engineering spec at 1a (+ architect 2, QA review 3a) with diagrams + traceability
body:
product-design-spec (stage 1a) must emit a PER-FEATURE engineering spec keyed by F-x: functional spec (behavior/rules/validation/edge cases/errors), UX spec (screens/components/states incl empty-loading-error/a11y WCAG 2.1 AA), DIAGRAMS (state machine, user flow, sequence, ER/data model, component), API contracts, data model, per-feature NFRs, and a test plan. architect (stage 2) adds cross-cutting architecture/API/data model/ADRs. validate (stage 3a) reviews it and drives a bounded change loop. Populate product-plan.json features[].requirements (F->FR/NFR/US) + requirements_index, and generate traceability.json (F<->FR<->NFR<->test).

[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] ARTIFACT MODEL = per-feature files (option 1B).
Stages 1 (design/functional spec) and 1a (product-design-spec) MUST emit ONE FILE PER FEATURE
(e.g. artifacts/1/features/F-1-functional.md, artifacts/1a/features/F-1-design.md) PLUS a per-stage
index, while KEEPING the existing merged <agent>-output.md so the downstream artifact contract does
not break.

decisions.note: Artifact model = per-feature files (option 1B): one file per feature + per-stage index; keep merged <agent>-output.md
